description: Use for 'are institutions buying or selling X?': each fund's position in one ticker classified new / increased / decreased / exited over the last ~4 quarters. For one strict-quarter verdict use ol_institutional_confluence. Returns {summary, ticker, quarters_analyzed, counts, new_positions, increased, decreased, exited, split_suspect, ...}. `counts` is always the COMPLETE tally; `limit` bounds EACH row list (default 10, hard cap 250), ranked by `sort_by` (default shares_change: largest buyer first). Pairs whose delta looks like an unconfirmed corporate action are withheld into `split_suspect` with their as-filed counts. Share classes are never summed or netted. Share figures are close approximations. Source: SEC EDGAR 13F-HR (public domain; OL derived).

limit.description: Max rows per bucket (default 10, hard cap 250); counts are complete regardless.

sort_by.description: Bucket ranking: shares_change (default, largest buyer / seller first), pct_change, or value (biggest positions).
